LanguageData.MOR_ModMenuNewsLetter_Title: Medieval Overhaul Royalty - New Configuration Menu
LanguageData.MOR_ModMenuNewsLetter_Text:
Medieval Overhaul Royalty now features its own configuration menu in your Mod Options!

Access it anytime through:
Options → Mod Options → Medieval Overhaul Royalty

Two new settings are available:

• Medieval Overhaul - Furniture Integration
Controls whether Medieval Overhaul items completely replace vanilla royal furniture, or are added as supplementary options.

• Medieval Overhaul - Empire Trader Integration
Determine if Medieval Overhaul goods dominate Empire trader stocks, or are mixed with vanilla items (incl. orbital trader).

Configure these settings to your preference and reload your game to apply the changes!
